statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-54704 affects opentelemetry-javaagent versions before 2.28.0-alpha. The fix version 2.28.0-alpha is an unreleased alpha build not yet available as a stable release. The vulnerability involves insertion of sensitive information into log files. Monitoring for stable 2.28.0 release.
